name: @epoch/agent-orchestration
description: Epoch Agent Orchestration kernel (W020): the typed orchestration MODEL — tenant-scoped plan/runbook descriptors whose steps are typed action PROPOSAL references (never embedded action semantics), capability-scoped agent bindings resolved against the W007 registry, deterministic content-addressed plan compilation (topological, sorted, identical inputs produce identical plans), retry/reconciliation policy shapes as typed data, idempotency keys, and the typed orchestration error taxonomy. The orchestration layer SCHEDULES — agents propose (W003), the Action Gateway authorizes (W022, future); this kernel never authorizes, executes, or embeds provider semantics.
